title: Taobao & Tmall Scraper Input
description: Scrape Taobao and Tmall products, SKUs, real final prices, shops, and search results in English and Chinese. Click Start to run with the prefilled keyword search.

startUrls.sectionDescription: Provide any mix of Taobao/Tmall URLs, numeric item IDs, or search keywords.
startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Product, short share link (e.tb.cn / m.tb.cn), shop, search, or category URLs on Taobao/Tmall. Example: https://detail.tmall.com/item.htm?id=1079352038299 or https://m.tb.cn/h.5xyz123

itemIds.title: Item IDs
itemIds.description: Numeric Taobao or Tmall product IDs (5 to 20 digits). Example: ["1079352038299", "1019865884154", "1069464409891"]

keywords.title: Search Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords to search on Taobao and Tmall. Example: ["蓝牙耳机", "机械键盘"]

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max Items Per Query
maxItemsPerQuery.description: Maximum products to scrape per keyword, search URL, category URL, or shop URL. Example: 20

minPrice.sectionDescription: Optional price, platform, shipping origin, and sort filters for keyword and search URLs.
minPrice.title: Min Price (CNY)
minPrice.description: Minimum product price in Chinese Yuan (CNY) for search results. Example: 50

maxPrice.title: Max Price (CNY)
maxPrice.description: Maximum product price in Chinese Yuan (CNY) for search results. Example: 500

tmallOnly.title: Tmall Only
tmallOnly.description: Keep only Tmall (天猫) products in search results. Example: true

location.title: Ship From Location
location.description: Filter search results by shipping province or city in Chinese. Example: 深圳 or 广州

sort.title: Sort Order
sort.description: Sort order for search results. Example: sales
enumTitles: Price: Low to High (价格从低到高)
Price: High to Low (价格从高到低)

includeDetails.sectionDescription: Control detail extraction, English translation, currency conversion, and shopping agent links.
includeDetails.title: Include Full Details & SKUs
includeDetails.description: Fetch full product details, SKU variants, attributes, and real final prices after coupons. Example: true

includeShopInfo.title: Include Shop & Seller Ratings
includeShopInfo.description: Include shop name, URL, DSR seller scores, credit level, and shop age. Example: true

translateToEnglish.title: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Translate Chinese titles, SKU labels, and attributes to English while keeping Chinese originals. Example: true

translationProvider.title: Translation Provider
translationProvider.description: Engine used for English translation: free Google (best-effort, may be rate-limited), DeepL API, or Google Cloud. Example: gtx

translationApiKey.title: Translation API Key
translationApiKey.description: API key for DeepL or Google Cloud when selected above. Example: your-deepl-key:fx

currency.title: Target Currency
currency.description: Currency code used to convert CNY prices into priceConverted. Example: USD

agentLinks.title: Shopping Agent Links
agentLinks.description: Cross-border shopping agent links to include on each product. Example: ["superbuy", "cnfans"]

monitoringMode.sectionDescription: Track price and stock changes across scheduled runs.
monitoringMode.title: Monitoring Mode (Delta Only)
monitoringMode.description: Emit only new or changed items compared to the previous run and include previousValues. Example: false

monitoringKey.title: Monitoring State Key
monitoringKey.description: Custom name to isolate monitoring history for a specific watchlist. Example: headphones-watchlist

proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Residential proxy configuration, country selection, session warm-up, Playwright fallback, and optional cookies.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy (RESIDENTIAL) or custom proxyUrls with sticky sessions. Example: {"useApifyProxy": true, "apifyProxyGroups": ["RESIDENTIAL"]}

proxyCountry.title: Residential Proxy Country
proxyCountry.description: Preferred RESIDENTIAL proxy country (default CN, with automatic fallback across HK, TW, SG, and US if blocked or unavailable). Example: CN
enumTitles: Mainland China (CN) — Default with HK/TW/SG Auto-Fallback

enableSessionWarmup.title: Enable Session Warm-Up
enableSessionWarmup.description: Warm up each sticky proxy session by visiting Taobao pages with browser headers to collect _m_h5_tk, _m_h5_tk_enc, cna, and t cookies before signing MTOP requests, and retire sessions automatically on RGV587 blocks.

enablePlaywrightFallback.title: Enable Playwright Browser Fallback
enablePlaywrightFallback.description: Fall back to one shared headless Chromium browser (mobile profile) when HTTP/MTOP endpoints are blocked. Turns itself off after 3 failed items in a row.

taobaoCookies.title: Taobao Logged-In Cookies (Optional)
taobaoCookies.description: Optional logged-in Taobao/Tmall cookie string (key=value; ...) or Cookie-Editor JSON array as a last-resort bypass when anti-bot challenges block anonymous requests.

maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Fine-tune human-like request concurrency and legacy cookie alias.
maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum parallel requests (keep low between 1 and 5 for human-like pacing with 1-4s random delays). Example: 2

cookie.title: Taobao Cookie (Legacy Alias)
cookie.description: Legacy alias for taobaoCookies. Optional browser Cookie header for signed-in sessions. Example: _m_h5_tk=...
